checked_invariants: peer edges point forward in task order
peer edges do not duplicate direct or transitive dependency paths
accepted edges have at least one proposal with confidence >= 0.8
peer fan-out per sender is at most 8
dependency plus peer successors per sender are at most 12
accepted peer edges per goal are at most 24
stored recipients exactly match accepted host edges
reapplying the same proposals is stable
limitations: Synthetic weighted-random task graphs and proposals; this is not a model accuracy benchmark.
The property test validates host graph policy, not Cloudflare multi-isolate storage contention or live provider behavior.
